# ISO 14001 & ESG Malaysia (esgiso.com)

> ISO 14001:2015 environmental management system (EMS) consulting and ESG readiness support in Malaysia, provided by AA Alive Sdn Bhd. We prepare organisations for certification by an accredited certification body (CB). The certificate is issued by the CB, not by us.

## Company
- Legal name: AA Alive Sdn Bhd
- SSM registration: 1204108-D
- Address: 1, Jalan Perusahaan 4, Pusat Industri Amari, 68100 Batu Caves, Selangor, Malaysia
- Operating since: 2016
- Founder and Managing Director: Evin Lim

## Services
- ISO 14001 environmental management system consulting
- Gap analysis
- EMS documentation development
- Staff awareness training and internal auditor training
- Internal audit support
- Preparation and support for the certification body audit (Stage 1 and Stage 2)
- ESG reporting framework setup and carbon baseline measurement
- Integrated management systems combining ISO 14001 with ISO 9001 and ISO 45001

## Pricing
- SME package (under 50 employees, single site): consulting RM 7,500, plus certification body audit RM 7,650
- Professional package (50–200 employees, up to 3 sites): RM 22,000
- Enterprise package (200+ employees, multi-site): custom quotation
- Certification body (CB) audit fees are quoted separately based on your chosen CB.
- The first consultation is free.
